about: Exact normalized expected branch-length spectra xi_hat_i = E[L_i]/sum_j E[L_j], i = 1..19, for Lambda-coalescents at sample size n = 20, constant population size, unfolded, as exact num/den strings: Kingman; Beta(2-alpha, alpha) for the listed alpha; Dirac (Lambda = delta_psi) for the listed psi. 'checks' is the identity_checks(20) block (checks 1-5 exact booleans, check 6 a display float). Each row also carries the exact value F = <w, xi_hat> + w0 of the functional in kingman_class_functional_n20.json ('witness_margin_exact') and its sign. Reproduce with popcorn/lambda_exact.py --out FILE.
